objective: Re-derive WIDE-LEFT-20261110-001A's Theorem (W) from scratch with every constant and quantifier explicit (the transfer to n + 1 pigeons with literal variable sets, the reduction through the decoder, the spare-row lemma, the density count); state exactly which of Braun's results it uses, check their Lean statements against the use, and say which the earlier fresh-kernel replay covers; record the outcome of adversarial reviews by fresh reviewers who did not see the proof, and sanity checks against known upper bounds and computed minimum sizes; or name the failing step.
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (V1, conditional on A55): WIDE-LEFT-20261110-001A's bound re-derived with explicit constants and attacked by four fresh reviewers; every step holds. Not new in substance: the 2n-pigeon formula is Pudlak-Thapen's rWPHP_n and exp(Omega(n)) for it and for LP_{n+1} follows from Pang's degree-size relation (arXiv 2610.00837).
title: The left-pigeon bound re-derived and audited
